recommendations.headline: Only 20% of 2,480 calls become orders while 46% end as vague callbacks, and the gap is driven by call quality, not price - satisfied calls convert at 72% vs just 5% for dissatisfied ones.
behaviour: Price is the dominant driver of calls: price_enquiry is the top intent (849/2480, 34%), price_shopper is the top behaviour tag (431), and price_high is the top objection (339).
Customers need technical help as much as price: needs_technical_help (354), technical_advice need (397) and product_info intent (469) show many calls are consultative, not just transactional.
Urgency is common but under-served: 338 calls are high-urgency and urgent_buyer is tagged 267 times, yet fast_delivery (459) and delivery_time objections (203) remain top pain points.
61% of calls end unresolved (callback 1140 + unclear 378 of 2480), showing most conversations stall rather than close.
Dealers drive volume and perform best (1185 calls, 41% win) while 'unknown' segment calls (910, 37% of total) convert at only 25% - many customers are never properly profiled.
satisfaction: Only 35% of calls end 'satisfied' (875/2480) vs 52% neutral and 8% dissatisfied, but the win-rate gap is stark: satisfied 72%, neutral 15%, dissatisfied just 5%.

Price is rarely even discussed: 70% of calls (1739) show 'not_discussed' price reaction, while only 3% (77) explicitly say price is too high - the issue is process/follow-through, not price resistance.
When price is discussed, acceptance is healthy (273 accepted vs 391 negotiating vs 77 too-high), suggesting the price itself is not the main blocker.
Rep execution gaps strongly correlate with poor satisfaction: slow_or_unclear_answer (406) and no_follow_up_fixed (393) are the top two missed actions.

conversion.title: Fix follow-up discipline
conversion.evidence: 393 calls show no_follow_up_fixed and 1140 calls (46%) end as vague 'callback' outcomes
conversion.action: Require every rep to set and log a specific callback date/time in CRM before ending a call, with automated reminders to call back.

conversion.title: Send quotes immediately
conversion.evidence: 230 calls show no_quote_sent, price_enquiry is 34% of intents, and 70% of calls never reach a price discussion
conversion.action: Mandate that every price/product enquiry ends with a WhatsApp quote sent within a few hours of the call.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order
conversion.action: Coach reps to explicitly ask for order confirmation whenever a customer shows interest, instead of ending the call open-ended.

conversion.title: Speed up and clarify answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the single biggest missed action (406 calls); satisfied calls convert at 72% vs 5% for dissatisfied
conversion.action: Build a quick-reference sheet of current rates, specs and stock so reps can answer instantly without 'I'll check and call back'.

conversion.title: Offer alternatives on stock-outs
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is the 2nd top objection (333, win 26%) and didnt_offer_alternative occurs 134 times
conversion.action: Train reps to always propose an alternate color/thickness/brand in the same call when the exact item is unavailable.

conversion.title: Profile unknown callers early
conversion.evidence: 'unknown' segment is 910 calls (37%) but wins only 25% vs dealer's 41%
conversion.action: Have reps ask and log customer type (dealer/fabricator/contractor/end-user) at the start of every call to route pricing and offers correctly.

conversion.title: Give firm delivery commitments upfront
conversion.evidence: delivery_time is a top objection (203, win 25%) and fast_delivery is the #1 stated need (459)
conversion.action: Quote a realistic delivery window on every order call and proactively update customers if it changes, rather than waiting for them to chase.

offers.title: Priority/express delivery slot
offers.why: 267 urgent_buyer tags, 338 high-urgency calls, and fast_delivery is the top stated need (459)

offers.title: Cutting/customisation service as a lead feature
offers.why: cutting_processing need (101) and multiple well-converted calls involved cutting-to-size requests

offers.title: Consider a structured credit facility for regular dealers
offers.why: needs_credit behaviour (96) and credit_period need (82); credit_terms objection has one of the better win rates (29%) when addressed

offers.title: Digital documentation service (quote/test cert/invoice via WhatsApp)
offers.why: test_certificate need (19), quality_assurance need (126), and multiple calls explicitly ask for certs/invoices on WhatsApp instead of with the driver

offers.title: Proactive status-update service
offers.why: regular_updates is a top need (206) and no_follow_up_fixed is the #2 missed rep action (393)

offers.title: Accessory bundling with sheet orders
offers.why: Screws (108) and welding rods (67) are frequently ordered alongside sheets in call summaries

loyalty.title: Tiered recognition program for repeat/bulk dealers
loyalty.how: Offer priority stock allocation, dedicated support or small festival gifts to top-tier repeat and bulk buyers
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer (220) and bulk_buyer (223) are common, but loyal_to_us is tagged only 19 times - a big untapped gap; Diwali gift was explicitly asked about twice

loyalty.title: Reserved stock for top dealers
loyalty.how: Pre-allocate stock for key accounts during shortages so they are never turned away
loyalty.why: stock_availability is the #2 objection (333) and dealers have the best win rate (41%) - protecting this relationship pays off

loyalty.title: Single named point-of-contact for key accounts
loyalty.how: Assign one account manager/number per key dealer or fabricator to avoid confusion
loyalty.why: Call summaries show customer confusion ('which number should I call', 'redirected to another number')

loyalty.title: Referral recognition
loyalty.how: Formally acknowledge and thank customers who refer new business, even without discounts
loyalty.why: referral behaviour tag appears 27 times, showing organic word-of-mouth that could be reinforced

loyalty.title: Consistent-supply commitment for industrial/bulk clients
loyalty.how: Proactively plan and communicate production/stock schedules to large or industrial buyers
loyalty.why: consistent_supply need (121) is a recurring theme, especially in fabricator/industrial calls

non_price_benefits.title: Technical consultation, not just sales
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help (354), technical_advice need (397), and product_info intent (469) show customers value expert guidance

non_price_benefits.title: Fast dispatch and site delivery
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery (459) and site_delivery (103) are top needs; several 'well-converted' calls closed on same-day/evening delivery promises

non_price_benefits.title: Wide colour and thickness range incl. Color On Plus bulk colours
non_price_benefits.why: Frequent colour queries (grey, off-white, sky blue, CG green) were successfully resolved in summaries, showing range as a differentiator

non_price_benefits.title: In-house cutting/customisation
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need (101) and multiple successful calls involved same-day cutting requests

non_price_benefits.title: Quality assurance with test certificates
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt is a top objection (93) and test_certificate/quality_assurance are named needs (19 and 126)

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor credibility
non_price_benefits.why: JSW is the most-mentioned competitor/brand (61) and Color On Plus is the #2 top product (272), showing brand trust is a strong lever

top_questions.question: What is the rate/price for this product?
top_questions.answer_tip: Quote the current rate promptly, confirm if GST is included, and offer to send a written quote on WhatsApp immediately.

top_questions.question: Is stock available and in what quantity?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock during the call; if unavailable, offer the closest alternate colour/thickness and a realistic restock date.

top_questions.question: Can you deliver today/tomorrow by a specific time?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a firm delivery window based on the dispatch schedule and proactively notify the customer if it changes.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price or match a competitor's rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Avoid quoting discounts; redirect to value - authorised JSW stock, quality assurance, and reliable service.

top_questions.question: Is this the right quality/GSM/coating, and is it genuine?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain specs and coating details clearly and offer to share the test certificate for confidence.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/invoice/test certificate on WhatsApp?
top_questions.answer_tip: Always send documentation digitally the same day rather than relying on the delivery driver.

top_questions.question: Do you offer credit terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain the current credit policy consistently and escalate special requests to a manager rather than leaving it unanswered.

top_questions.question: Will there be a festival (Diwali) gift this year?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm the current festival-gift policy with management and communicate it consistently to build goodwill.
